segments.t: Pick up Coming of Age from Ailee Farheart. The follow-up conversation is with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
Hand Coming of Age over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Harmony in Balance from Rorian the Dayseeker. The kill count is 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
Work through Harmony in Balance at Juvenile Vuldren.
Hand Harmony in Balance over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Infestation Investigation from Elatrell Featherlight. The kill count is 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
Work through Infestation Investigation at Pesky Cirrusfly.
Hand Infestation Investigation over to Elatrell Featherlight.
Pick up The Cirrusfly Queen from Elatrell Featherlight. Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
Work through The Cirrusfly Queen at Cirrusfly Queen.
Hand The Cirrusfly Queen over to Elatrell Featherlight.
Pick up The Way of the Hunter from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove and do what it asks.
Hand The Way of the Hunter over to Tai'ree Farsight.
Pick up Embracing the Elements from Rorian the Dayseeker. Inspect the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
Hand Embracing the Elements over to Windshaper Boro.
Pick up A Student of Nature from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove and do what it asks.
Hand A Student of Nature over to Xyton Silverwind.
Pick up At Home in the Shadows from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove and do what it asks.
Hand At Home in the Shadows over to Akeri Duskblade.
Pick up The Warrior's Path from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower and do what it asks.
Hand The Warrior's Path over to Blademaster Ren.
Pick up Elemental Unrest from Rorian the Dayseeker. Continue the talk with Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
Hand Elemental Unrest over to Yala Windwatcher.
Pick up The Gift of Skysight from Ventaari Brightwish. The item this step wants used is your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
Work through The Gift of Skysight at Elemental Convergence.
Hand The Gift of Skysight over to Ventaari Brightwish.
Pick up The Anchors of Zephras from Halaan Hawk-Eye. The follow-up conversation is with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
Hand The Anchors of Zephras over to Halaan Hawk-Eye.
Pick up Falling With Style from Myriaal Mistwake. Make the jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
Work through Falling With Style at the objective.
Hand Falling With Style over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Call of Earth from Windshaper Boro. Carry a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
Work through Call of Earth at Al'Aketh Convert.
Hand Call of Earth over to Windshaper Boro.
Pick up Agitators from Yala Windwatcher. The kill count is 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
Work through Agitators at Roiling Winds.
Hand Agitators over to Yala Windwatcher.
Pick up Return to Rorian from Yala Windwatcher. Carry word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
Hand Return to Rorian over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Aetheen of the Gales from Rorian the Dayseeker. The follow-up conversation is with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
Hand Aetheen of the Gales over to Aetheen of the Gales.
Pick up Call of Earth from Windshaper Boro. Locate the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
Hand Call of Earth over to Minor Manifestation of Earth.
Pick up Call of Earth from Minor Manifestation of Earth. Carry the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
Hand Call of Earth over to Windshaper Boro.
Pick up Foul Matriarch from Aetheen of the Gales. The kill count is 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
Pick up Aggressive Encroachment from Valreaa Valewind. Bring back 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
Accept Harvesting Windstones from Dalia the Collector.
Pick up Al'Aketh Thugs from Hanaa Nightwind. The kill count is 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
Work through Foul Matriarch at Ursera Scavenger.
Work through Aggressive Encroachment at Scrawny Ursera.
Complete Harvesting Windstones.
Work through Al'Aketh Thugs at Al'Aketh Neophyte.
Hand Al'Aketh Thugs over to Hanaa Nightwind.
Hand Foul Matriarch over to Aetheen of the Gales.
Turn in Harvesting Windstones to Dalia the Collector.
Hand Aggressive Encroachment over to Valreaa Valewind.
Pick up The Adventurer from Aetheen of the Gales. Continue the talk with Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
Pick up The Next Step from Aetheen of the Gales. Check in with Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
Hand The Adventurer over to Raan Wildwind.
Pick up The Great Outdoors from Raan Wildwind. The objective is to sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
Work through The Great Outdoors at Basic Campfire.
Hand The Great Outdoors over to Raan Wildwind.

tips.text: Campfire buffs (Fish Bowl +8% stats at Fishing 20, and other players' camp items) are optional. The route works with none of them. A Camp Tent only fills rested xp up to 5% of a level and does nothing if you already have more.
Cooking a basic meal gives Well Fed: +5% kill xp for 15 minutes, if you keep food on hand. The route does not require it.

segments.t: Hand The Next Step over to Constable Aonda.
Pick up Welcome to Shen'dar Village from Constable Aonda. The follow-up conversation is with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
Work through Welcome to Shen'dar Village at Illaya Amberwind.
Hand Welcome to Shen'dar Village over to Constable Aonda.
Pick up Pilfered Windstones from Teeri Wellwind. Bring back 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Pick up Hippogryph Harassment from Teeri Wellwind. The kill count is 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Pick up The Problem With Prideclaws from Indari Sunseam. Bring back 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
Pick up A Little Beauty from Taleen Shimmerthread. Bring back 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Pick up The Criminal Element from Constable Aonda. The kill count is 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Accept Restocking the Larders from Zerril Softbreeze.
Accept WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable from Bounty Available: Vulgara the Insatiable!.
Pick up The Windshapers from Illaya Amberwind. Stay and listen: to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
Hand The Windshapers over to Illaya Amberwind.

Work through Meddlesome Mages at High Order Apprentice.
Work through The Criminal Element at Highlands Bandit.
Work through Pilfered Windstones at Highlands Bandit.
Work through The Problem With Prideclaws at Prideclaw.
Complete WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable.
Work through Hippogryph Harassment at Hippogryph Youth.
Work through A Little Beauty at Hippogryph Down.
Complete Restocking the Larders.
Hand Pilfered Windstones over to Teeri Wellwind.
Hand Hippogryph Harassment over to Teeri Wellwind.
Hand The Problem With Prideclaws over to Indari Sunseam.
Hand A Little Beauty over to Taleen Shimmerthread.
Hand The Criminal Element over to Constable Aonda.
Hand Meddlesome Mages over to Illaya Amberwind.
Turn in WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable to Danarii Bellowveil.
Turn in Restocking the Larders to Zerril Softbreeze.
Pick up Infiltrating the Cult from Constable Aonda. The follow-up conversation is with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
Hand Infiltrating the Cult over to Sania Silverstream.
Pick up Falaath Village from Sania Silverstream. Check in with Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.
Hand Falaath Village over to Missionary Jasaan.
Pick up Among the Faithful from Missionary Jasaan. Search Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Work through Among the Faithful at Wardrobe.
Hand Among the Faithful over to Constable Aonda.
Pick up The Western Watch from Constable Aonda. Locate Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
Pick up Havoc in the Highlands from Constable Aonda. The next place is the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
Work through Havoc in the Highlands at Al'Aketh Stormcaller.
Hand The Western Watch over to Peacekeeper Vaaniel.
Pick up A Last Request from Peacekeeper Vaaniel. Pick up the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
Work through A Last Request at Skypriest Aanders.
Hand Havoc in the Highlands over to Constable Aonda.
Hand A Last Request over to Constable Aonda.

Pick up To Valanaar from Constable Aonda. Hand over Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. On the speedrun, move on once the local quests turn green; lower-level kills give less xp than in Classic.
Pick up Deliver the Signet from Constable Aonda. Hand over the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Hand To Valanaar over to Valennia Stormfist.
Set your hearthstone at Donaal Downbreeze

actions.label: Set your hearthstone at Donaal Downbreeze

segments.t: Hand Deliver the Signet over to Talaanis Shadowsong.
Pick up Bugged from Valennia Stormfist. Clear Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
Work through Bugged at Skyhopper.
Hand Bugged over to Valennia Stormfist.
Pick up The Grand Skyseer from Valennia Stormfist. Locate Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

tips.text: This quest is tagged with the classic Tauren race bit and leaves the Skyborne bit unset. Treat the offer as unverified until the quest is actually available on a Windshaper.

segments.t: Hand The Grand Skyseer over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.
Pick up A Grand Adventure from Ayessa Dawnsinger. Stay and listen: to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
Hand A Grand Adventure over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.
Pick up The Broken Construct from Ayessa Dawnsinger. Locate Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
Hand The Broken Construct over to Riaani Nightwind.
Pick up The Broken Construct from Riaani Nightwind. The follow-up conversation is with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
Work through The Broken Construct at Riaani Nightwind.
Hand The Broken Construct over to Riaani Nightwind.
Accept Unwelcome Spirits from Endaria Mistgaze.
Pick up The Great Ursera Spirit from Lotheluum Starbreeze. The follow-up conversation is with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
Hand The Great Ursera Spirit over to Urs'endris.
Pick up Blood Tithe from Alvarion Windfield. Stay and listen: to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
Work through Blood Tithe at Aamelia Windfield.
Hand Blood Tithe over to Aamelia Windfield.
Pick up Make Yourself Useful from Aamelia Windfield. Bring back 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
Pick up Flutterfly Dust from Aamelia Windfield. Bring back 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
Pick up Ornery Ornery Galestriders from Aamelia Windfield. Bring back 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
Pick up What Is My Purpose? from Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct. The follow-up conversation is with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
Work through Make Yourself Useful at Hungry Bandit.
Work through Flutterfly Dust at Flutterfly Dust.
Work through Ornery Ornery Galestriders at Ornery Galestrider.
Hand Make Yourself Useful over to Aamelia Windfield.
Hand Flutterfly Dust over to Aamelia Windfield.
Hand Ornery Ornery Galestriders over to Aamelia Windfield.
Hand What Is My Purpose? over to Aamelia Windfield.
Pick up The Hills Have Eyes from Aamelia Windfield. Bring back 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Work through The Hills Have Eyes at Bandit Highwayman.
Hand The Hills Have Eyes over to Aamelia Windfield.
Pick up Standing Our Ground from Aamelia Windfield. The follow-up conversation is with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
Work through Standing Our Ground at Ferauu the Bludgeon.
Hand Standing Our Ground over to Aamelia Windfield.
Pick up Deliver the News from Aamelia Windfield. The follow-up conversation is with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
Hand Deliver the News over to Alvarion Windfield.
Pick up The Broken Construct from Riaani Nightwind. Check in again with Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
Hand The Broken Construct over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.
Pick up A Firm Response from Ayessa Dawnsinger. Face Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
Work through A Firm Response at Belathaan Brightwish.
Hand A Firm Response over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.
Pick up In Service of Zephras from Ayessa Dawnsinger. Check in with Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
Hand In Service of Zephras over to Valennia Stormfist.
Pick up Blood for Blood from Ayessa Dawnsinger. Bring back 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Pick up Tower Defense from Valennia Stormfist. Check in with Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Pick up The Skybreaker Bulwark from Seena Skybreaker. Recover the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
Accept Crab Season from Nyalah Brightfire.
Work through The Skybreaker Bulwark at Zaal Stormshield.
Complete Crab Season.
Hand The Skybreaker Bulwark over to Seena Skybreaker.
Turn in Crab Season to Nyalah Brightfire.
Hand Tower Defense over to Yorana Windyreed.
Pick up Disrupting Logistics from Yorana Windyreed. The kill count is 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Pick up Breaking the Breaker from Yorana Windyreed. Defeat Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Work through Disrupting Logistics at Al'Aketh Brawler.
Work through Breaking the Breaker at Commander Belguilos.
Hand Disrupting Logistics over to Yorana Windyreed.
Hand Breaking the Breaker over to Yorana Windyreed.
Pick up Strength and Mercy from Urs'endris. Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Work through Strength and Mercy at Ur'endra.
Hand Strength and Mercy over to Urs'endris.
Pick up Return to Valanaar from Yorana Windyreed. Carry Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
Hand Return to Valanaar over to Valennia Stormfist.

tips.text: Hunters: from level 10, see Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar (59.6, 72.6) for pet training. Taming the Beast from Elayaa Easewind needs level 10, so the route does not send you for it at level 6.

segments.t: Pick up Call of Fire from Sessaria Skystride in Valanaar. Carry the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.

tips.text: Shaman level 10 class quest; the chain gives your fire totem. The flame part is timed, so go straight back to Valanaar.

segments.t: Hand Call of Fire to Olariaan Swiftburn and take the next Call of Fire.
Kill Skypriest Faladiel and loot Faladiel's Heart.
Hand Call of Fire to Olariaan Swiftburn and take the next Call of Fire.
Find Kuramaa's home in the Shen'dar Highlands, beat the spirit and loot Kuramaa's Mask.
Hand Call of Fire to Olariaan Swiftburn and take the last Call of Fire. Wait for him to start the ritual at the Brazier of Offering.
Carry the Eternal Flame to the brazier in Valanaar before the timer runs out, then hand Call of Fire to Sessaria Skystride.
Pick up The High Elder's Request from Valennia Stormfist. The follow-up conversation is with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Hand The High Elder's Request over to Talaanis Shadowsong.
Pick up The Turncoat from Talaanis Shadowsong. Locate the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
Accept Al'Aketh Assassins from Fendaal Windstone.
Work through The Turncoat at DNT KILL CREDIT.
Complete Al'Aketh Assassins.
Hand The Turncoat over to Dead Cultist.
Turn in Al'Aketh Assassins to Fendaal Windstone.
Pick up Unfortunate News from Dead Cultist. Hand over the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Hand Unfortunate News over to Talaanis Shadowsong.
Pick up The Cult's True Plans from Talaanis Shadowsong. The follow-up conversation is with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
Hand The Cult's True Plans over to Talaanis Shadowsong.
Pick up Desperate Times from Talaanis Shadowsong. The follow-up conversation is with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
Work through Desperate Times at Valennia Stormfist.
Hand Desperate Times over to Valennia Stormfist.
Pick up Prepare for Battle from Valennia Stormfist. The follow-up conversation is with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Hand Prepare for Battle over to Valennia Stormfist.

Pick up Making Our Move from Valennia Stormfist. The kill count is 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
Work through Making Our Move at Al'Aketh Blademaster.
Hand Making Our Move over to Hyusaa Quickbreeze.
Pick up The Inner Sanctum from Hyusaa Quickbreeze. The follow-up conversation is with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
Hand The Inner Sanctum over to Valennia Stormfist.

Pick up Confront Lorthuna from Valennia Stormfist. From here, take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

tips.text: This quest is tagged with the classic Tauren race bit and leaves the Skyborne bit unset. Treat the offer as unverified until the quest is actually available on a Windshaper.

segments.t: Hand Confront Lorthuna over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.
Pick up The Fate of Zephras from Ayessa Dawnsinger. The follow-up conversation is with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Hand The Fate of Zephras over to Talaanis Shadowsong.
Pick up What Comes Next from Talaanis Shadowsong. The follow-up conversation is with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
Hand What Comes Next over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.

Pick up The Earthen Ring from Ayessa Dawnsinger. Board the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive. The quest names Mulgore and Alaana Stormwalker. It does not name a flight master, Skywatcher Plateau, or a ride on to Thunder Bluff. On the speedrun, move on once the local quests turn green; lower-level kills give less xp than in Classic.
Accept Aid For The Refugees from Ealaane Nimbuswalker.
Accept The Fate of a Loved One from Ealaane Nimbuswalker.

Accept Tears of the Lady from Elegael Thornpaw.
Accept Feathers for Binding from Elegael Thornpaw.
Accept Unwanted and Unworthy from Elegael Thornpaw.

Complete Unwanted and Unworthy.
Complete Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears.
Work through Blood for Blood at Al'Aketh Stormchaser.
Turn in Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears to Vayn Moongaze.
Complete Tears of the Lady.

Complete The Strange Hermit.
Turn in The Strange Hermit to Strange Hermit.

Accept Free the Hollows from Strange Hermit.
Complete The Forest's Bounty.
Complete Feathers for Binding.
Complete Free the Hollows.
Complete Unwelcome Spirits.
Complete Aid For The Refugees.
Complete The Fate of a Loved One.

Turn in Free the Hollows to Strange Hermit.
Turn in Tears of the Lady to Elegael Thornpaw.
Turn in Feathers for Binding to Elegael Thornpaw.
Turn in Unwanted and Unworthy to Elegael Thornpaw.
Accept The Ties That Bind from Elegael Thornpaw.
Accept The Wounds of Betrayal from Elegael Thornpaw.
Loot Ripped Missive, then accept Ripped Missive.
Complete The Ties That Bind.
Complete The Wounds of Betrayal.
Turn in The Ties That Bind to Elegael Thornpaw.
Turn in The Wounds of Betrayal to Elegael Thornpaw.
Turn in Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw.
Accept The Fate of the Den from Elegael Thornpaw.
Hand Blood for Blood over to Ayessa Dawnsinger.
Turn in Unwelcome Spirits to Endaria Mistgaze.
Turn in Aid For The Refugees to Ealaane Nimbuswalker.
Turn in The Fate of a Loved One to Ealaane Nimbuswalker.

segments.t: Turn in The Fate of the Den to Lotheluum Starbreeze.
Hand The Earthen Ring over to Alaana Stormwalker.

tips.text: This pack ends with Alaana Stormwalker after The Earthen Ring. Quest 95350, from the same NPC, points at Thrall in Orgrimmar. A join from here into the existing Mulgore 1-12 leveling route is not in the quest text and stays unverified. No flight-master coordinates were added.
